findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials or secrets
 * @description Hardcoded credentials in source code can be extracted by attackers
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::Node assignment, string value
where
  exists(Assign a, StrConst s |
    assignment.asExpr() = a.getValue() and
    s = a.getValue() and
    value = s.getText() and
    (
      a.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%passwd%", "%secret%", "%api_key%", "%apikey%", "%token%", "%auth%"]) or
      a.getATarget().(Attribute).getName().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%passwd%", "%secret%", "%api_key%", "%apikey%", "%token%", "%auth%"])
    ) and
    value.length() > 8 and
    not value.matches(["", "password", "secret", "token", "%test%", "%example%", "%dummy%", "%TODO%"])
  )
select assignment, "Potential hardcoded credential: " + value
findings.hypothesis: Check for hardcoded credentials, API keys, or secrets in the codebase

message.text:
Potential hardcoded credential: 
      (?=
        \s         # whitespace
        | ;        # comment
        | \#\[;|!\] # fancy comments
        | \[)\\]\]    # end delimiters
        | $        # end of file
      )

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess call with shell=True
 * @description Using shell=True in subprocess calls can lead to command injection vulnerabilities
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe subprocess or os call that may allow command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Detect subprocess calls with shell=True or os.system usage that could be vulnerable to command injection

message.text: Potentially unsafe subprocess or os call that may allow command injection.
